title: Closed quest item actions
description: Finite explicit item consumers; actions never add objective rows or execute arbitrary effects.

actions.description: The currently supported Guardian-owned Orb consumer.

questId.description: The quest owning the action and its retained proof.

areaId.description: Canonical action location in its owning act.

targetId.description: Explicit object at which the item is consumed.

inputSource.description: Exact assembled input source; action receipts cannot themselves be inputs.

itemId.description: Exact real assembled input, never a gear instance or matching flag.
